name: Replant Click
summary: Right-click ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes or beetroots to harvest them and plant the next crop in the same move.
logoPrompt: A single bright orange carrot popping up out of a farmland block, with a glowing green circular arrow looping around it

cover.tagline: Harvest and replant with one click.

description: **Replant Click lets you farm with right-clicks: click a fully grown crop and it drops its harvest and starts growing again on the spot.**
- Works on wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroots once they are fully grown; young crops stay as they are.
- One seed from the harvest goes back into the ground, the rest drops for you, so a field never needs replanting by hand.
- The harvest counts as broken with the item in your hand, so a Fortune hoe still gives more.
- No trampled farmland, no broken blocks, no empty spots in your field.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Right-click a ripe crop with an empty hand or any tool. Sneak to place blocks next to crops as usual; bone meal keeps working too.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. On a server only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
